items.prompt: There are 9 ducks on the pond. 4 more ducks swim to the pond. Then 3 ducks fly away.
hints: Add for the ducks that join.
9 + 4 is the number on the pond after the 4 arrive.
items.explanation: 9 + 4 = 13 ducks. Then 13 - 3 = 10 ducks. 10 is more than the 9 at the start.

parts.prompt: How many ducks are on the pond after 4 more swim to it?
How many ducks are on the pond after 3 fly away?
Are there more ducks or fewer ducks than at the start?
